title: The Dreaming Tent
text: A silk tent pitched in the wilderness, empty, warm, and smelling of home: bread, smoke, the soap your mother used. Nobody has pitched it. Anyone who sleeps in it, the scrawl on the tent pole says, dreams very clearly, and does not always wake the same.

options.label: The most troubled lies down in the tent.

outcomes.text: The dream is gentle and long, and they wake up someone a little different, and lighter.
The dream is very, very clear, and it comes back every night after.
It is very good silk, and it still smells of home.

options.label: Burn it before anyone gets ideas.

outcomes.text: It burns with the smell of somebody's kitchen, and a voice calls a name from inside.
